subject: Mediconnect: backup purge timing & log-retention carveout for DPA
messages:
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@mediconnect.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mediconnect Legal <legal@mediconnect.com>, security@mediconnect.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Backup purge schedule + DPA carveout request

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the DPA draft — overall looks good. Two specific asks from our compliance/audit teams before we can sign:

1) Backup purge timeline: we need formal confirmation of how long backups (snapshots / object-level copies) are retained after a customer-initiated deletion and whether Redwood can provide a guaranteed maximum purge window for production data (including KV caches, persisted logs stored for debugging, and managed snapshots).

2) Log-retention carveout: our security team needs an exception to retain certain audit logs for up to 540 days for regulatory reasons; we understand this is outside your default retention. Please confirm whether Redwood will support a per-account retention carveout (and what controls/material support you can provide, e.g., separate bucket, encryption keys, access logs).

Can you also point us to the SOC2 artifact summary (if available) and a short summary of how deletion workflows are validated (i.e., provenance that deletion completed, verification steps)?

We'd like to close the DPA this week if possible.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Jenkins
Sr. Privacy Counsel | Mediconnect Health
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@mediconnect.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backup purge schedule + DPA carveout request

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear asks. Looping in Engineering and Legal to provide specifics and options. High level: we do have automated backup purge workflows and a standard 90-day snapshot/object backup retention after deletion; however, we offer account-level exceptions for enterprise contracts with controls.

Next steps:
- Kimberly (Legal) can confirm whether we can codify a 540-day log-retention carveout in the DPA and the contract language.
- Markus (Engineering) will outline the technical approach for segregated retention (separate bucket + KMS key + access controls) and confirm expected purge timeline and verifiability.
- I will upload the SOC2 artifact summary and a short runbook excerpt for deletion verification.

Can you confirm whether Mediconnect requires the logs to be accessible to you (read access) during the extended retention or whether retention combined with export on request is sufficient?

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@mediconnect.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backup purge schedule + DPA carveout request

Hi all — technical details below.

Summary: standard behavior is 90 days for backups and snapshots following a customer deletion request. For enterprise carveouts we can support a segregated retention path with the following constraints/controls:

- Implementation: provision a customer-specific object prefix + dedicated KMS key; backups that need extended retention are copied to that prefix and marked in metadata. Purge workflows will skip objects with that tag until end-of-retention.
- Expected purge window: for segregated copies we guarantee final purge within 30 days after the extended retention period ends. Example: a 540-day retention would result in objects being deleted within 30 days after day 540.
- Verification: we emit deletion-proof events to the customer audit log stream and we can provide a signed purge manifest (timestamped list of purged objects) on request. We also retain a short-lived (30d) signed manifest in our secure archive for dispute resolution.
- Logs / audit events: application and request logs are kept separately from backups. If Mediconnect needs logs preserved for 540 days, we can support that via the segregated retention path but we need to agree on access controls and storage pricing adjustments.
- Cost/ops note: extended retention increases storage costs and slightly increases recovery/restore complexity. We recommend a periodic sync (quarterly) to validate exported manifests.

I'll attach a concise retention matrix.

- Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Staff Engineer, Storage & Persistence | Redwood Inference

Attachment: retention_matrix_redwood_6-2026.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@mediconnect.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: markus_klein <markus@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backup purge schedule + DPA carveout request

Hi Alice — quick legal confirmation.

We can include a per-account retention carveout in the DPA that specifies: (1) the retention period (e.g., 540 days), (2) the segregated storage approach (customer-specific prefix + KMS), (3) a purge window (we propose the 30-day post-retention final purge Markus described), and (4) an obligation to provide a signed purge manifest on deletion completion.

Two clarifications needed from Mediconnect before we finalize language:
- Whether Mediconnect requires read access to the retained logs during the extended retention (if yes, we will define read-only export or S3-compatible temporary credentials);
- Any regulatory requirement that would require transfer of those logs to a specific geography — we support region-restricted storage but need to know the target region.

Also attaching a SOC2 summary for your security team. Once you confirm the two points above we'll incorporate the carveout language into the DPA and re-share the PDF.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

Attachment: soc2-summary-redwood.pdf (pdf)
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@mediconnect.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@mediconnect.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backup purge schedule + DPA carveout request

Thanks — this is very helpful. Answers below:

- Mediconnect does NOT require continuous read access to retained logs. We only need the logs preserved and exported on request for audits (read-only export). Occasional access via temporary credentials or export delivery is fine.
- Geography: logs must remain in the US (no cross-border transfer).

Next steps from our side: we'll mark the DPA with the 540-day carveout and US-only storage. Please include the 30-day post-retention purge window and the signed purge manifest obligation. Once the DPA reflects those items we'll proceed with signature.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to sign once updated.

Best,
Alice
Alice Jenkins
Sr. Privacy Counsel | Mediconnect Health
